onset.Description: HOMER2 t time relative to the first acquired sample; derived from a non-zero entry in the corresponding s column.

duration.Description: The source s matrix stores sample impulses and does not provide marker durations; zero denotes an instantaneous marker, not the 69-second audio duration.

trial_type.Description: The source file contains three unlabeled s columns. They are preserved as generic conditions because their exact meanings were not supplied.

Levels.condition_1: Non-zero marker in HOMER2 s column 1
Levels.condition_2: Non-zero marker in HOMER2 s column 2
Levels.condition_3: Non-zero marker in HOMER2 s column 3

marker_value.Description: Value from the corresponding non-zero sample in the source HOMER2 s matrix.

source_session.Description: Session ID of the event TSV associated by ascending session order with this marker block.

session_timestamp.Description: Timestamp copied from the matched source event table; timezone is not specified.

left_channel_mp3.Description: Filename copied from the matched source event table.

right_channel_mp3.Description: Filename copied from the matched source event table.

target_speaker.Description: Value copied from the source Target f/m column.

target_location.Description: Value copied from the source Target l/r column.
